forge.setup.required: Configure an LLM model here before using Prompt Forge or an AI helper. Your draft has been kept; no generation was started.
forge.setup.environment: Install or open a DEAS environment first, then add a local GGUF model or configure an LLM server.
forge.noModels: No LLM model found: add a GGUF to ComfyUI/models/llm or set a server under Backend → LLM
forge.noBackend: Start the backend of an installed environment to use Prompt Forge.
forge.noDialect: Prompt Forge has no prompt style for this model
forge.outdated: Prompt Forge needs a newer DaSiWa node pack on the backend: Backend → Upgrade.
forge.pick: Pick pictures from the input folder:
forge.detectHelp: Needs a vision model. Detection creates candidates; current boxes change only when you use them. Matching counts retain the existing identities left to right. Cancel discards the result and requests a best-effort stop.
forge.detectInput: Detection needs an installed backend and a picture inside its input folder. Manual boxes still work.
forge.detectCount: Detected {count} people. Review numbering after applying.
forge.detectNone: No people found. Current boxes are unchanged; use manual boxes instead.
forge.detectCancelled: Result discarded; a best-effort backend stop was requested. Current boxes are unchanged.
forge.detectVision: Choose a vision-capable model to find people.
forge.detectBusy: The backend is busy. Retry after the workflow or Forge finishes.
forge.boxHint: Boxes override the people/order selection. Drag a box to move it or its corner to resize; arrow keys work on focused boxes and handles. Sources are unchanged.
forge.boxImageError: Could not load the reference picture for box editing.
forge.peopleHint: Tap character numbers in order. Tap again to remove; at least one stays. Changing the picture label resets this selection.
forge.see: Let the model see the pictures (needs a vision model)
forge.blind: This model cannot see pictures; it wrote from the text only.
forge.stale: This draft was written for other settings (mode, duration, canvas, references or model). Write again to apply it.
forge.cast: Cast & scene cards (optional; Read needs a vision model)
